blocks.text: Artificial Intelligence (AI), Internet of Things (IoT) aur Blockchain jaisi emerging technologies insani zindagi ke kai pehluon par asar dalti hain, privacy aur rozgar se le kar faisla sazi aur hifazat tak. Munasib qawaneen aur regulations ke baghair in technologies ka ghalat istemal ho sakta hai ya yeh na-insafi wale nataij de sakti hain. Policies tay karti hain ke data kaise jama, store aur use ho, taake hifazat ho aur logon ke huqooq bache rahein.

Duniya bhar mein Europe ka General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) jaise dhaanche data ki hifazat aur privacy ke miyar tay karte hain. Bain-ul-aqwami AI ethics guidelines khud-kaar faislon (automated decision-making) mein transparency aur insaf ko farogh deti hain. Qaumi satah par mulk apni AI strategies bana rahe hain taake nayi ijaad zimmedari se ho. Pakistan bhi aise dhaanche apna kar yaqeeni bana sakta hai ke technology ki tarakki akhlaqi miyar ke mutabiq ho aur shehriyon ke mafadat mehfooz rahein.

blocks.prompt: Qawaneen ke baghair emerging technologies se kya khatra hai, aur policies kya tay karti hain?
blocks.explanation: Technologies ka ghalat istemal ho sakta hai ya na-insafi wale nataij aa sakte hain. Policies tay karti hain ke data kaise jama, store aur use ho, taake hifazat aur logon ke huqooq bache rahein.

items: AI governance: AI ke zimmedarana istemal ke qawaid aur policies.
GDPR, international AI ethics guidelines aur qaumi AI strategies; Pakistan ke liye bhi aise frameworks.
